evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies address relay key serialization across network types in src/netaddress.cpp and src/addrman.cpp.
rationale: Prevents address relay suppression caused by cross-network key collisions between Tor and I2P in per-peer Bloom filters. The author notes that "in theory it would be possible for two I2P and Tor addresses to have the same output from CService::GetKey()", which would make a node assume a peer already knows an address on one network after sending an address with identical bytes on another.
